title: Brazil Serie B 2026 — score correction audit

score_reconstruction.method: Sum the existing Flashscore incident period-score markers: 1st Half (IG=home, IH=away) + 2nd Half (IG=home, IH=away). The incident records were used only to derive period scores; player names and event details were excluded.
score_reconstruction.home_score_consistency_check: 302/302 reconstructed home scores equal the existing fulltime_home field.
score_reconstruction.note: Scores were reconstructed from existing stored Flashscore period-score records. Individual Flashscore match pages were not independently re-opened one by one in this run; this is source-record reconstruction pending independent page-level spot checks.
